paragraphs.text: Susuki Village is a kitsune village on the Towabara Plains on plane of Kamigawa .

Susuki Village lay on the far edge of Towabara Plains , bordering the Jukai forest . The village was the home of the renowned elder Eight-and-a-Half-Tails , and its distance from Eiganjo meant that it was sheltered for much of the effects of the Kami War . Eight-and-a-Half-Tails stayed in the village when he was not out on missions, and could at times almost forget that the war even existed.
